admission.justification: A failed bound-index read must not become an immutable browser success that survives explicit Refresh; sharing pending work and isolating the question also prevent duplicate remount requests and cross-selection cards. Existing mounted tests directly assert those failures and recovery boundaries.

applicability: The dashboard browser module-shared card-answer/in-flight stores and useChangeSetCards consumer for a selected recorded comparison number and shown invariant chunks.
conditions: Question identity is repository, master, leaf, comparison number and a sorted distinct invariant chunk. The completed store holds at most20 chunk answers in insertion order; sharing in-flight requests does not impose a separate concurrency cap.
Only a trees-phase answer may be retained. Any unavailable-history knowledge or code side prevents retention; unavailable entry-memory prevents retention when the after knowledge side is available.

A genuinely legacy-unavailable after knowledge side is the recorded comparison's own state and does not by itself forbid retaining its trees answer. An absent entry_memory key is not manufactured into a failed facts state.

A failed fetch, refused/unreadable body or unkeepable trees answer remains this mount's visible answer but is not put in the shared completed store. A remount or the shared intent-entry refresh generation asks for an unkept question again; a kept answer is reused.

Same-key in-flight callers share one uncancelled request. Cleanup only prevents that consumer from setting mounted seen state; a changed question shows only its own held/seen answer or loading, not a prior question's cards.
With disabled reading or no comparison number the hook returns null and issues no card read; an empty invariant set needs no card request and yields the normal empty cards result.
exclusions: Server RecordedAnswerReuse observation stamps, dependency parity and live-vs-recorded reuse policy remain INV-YTPBCF; no browser stamp/parity or indefinite freshness check is promised.
The parent process live worklist memo remains INV-5M9WY3, separate from this browser store.

Which subjects are shown, the opening schedule and500-invariant chunk/read limit remain INV-KEJ5TN. Producing the four bound memory values remains INV-8F35XR and unavailable-value sort behavior remains INV-S81G6W.

The leaf-wide useReviewTrees busy-retry delay schedule, abort cancellation, overall request concurrency caps, freshness beyond question identity, byte limits and cross-tab persistence are outside this policy.
